notes: A Tonight panel: a daily switchboard, separate from the permanent Limits, that can only ever take things off the decks — period night, no toys, no pain, no tying, no blindfold, no dressing up. It expires at midnight and can never grant permission a Limit has withheld. Act naming tightened: clamp became squeeze (the limit is the squeeze, not the object), undress reads as undressing before your partner, rope covers a toy used to hold you. Menu cards added for waking, risky, degrade and cuck, with game cards behind the first three so their gates actually remove something.
